lmsIntegration.registerPortalsDescription: Copy the registration URLs below and send them to the school's LMS administrator. After they register the LTI 1.3 tool in Moodle or Canvas, return here to enter the Client ID and complete setup.
lmsIntegration.setupStep1: Copy the registration URLs from the Educator Portal card.
lmsIntegration.setupStep2: Send them to the school's LMS admin to register the LTI 1.3 tool in Moodle or Canvas.
lmsIntegration.setupStep3: Once the tool is registered, return here and enter the Client ID, Issuer URL, and other values from the LMS.
lmsIntegration.setupStep4: Save LMS settings. Educators can then launch from the LMS and use Deep Linking to assign simulations.
lmsIntegration.setupStep5: Launch the tool from your LMS.
lmsIntegration.educatorPortalDescription: Send these URLs to the school's LMS admin for tool registration. One tool handles educator launches and Deep Linking. Educators pick simulations in the LMS to create course activities students can open.
lmsIntegration.toolUriHintEducator: Supports both standard educator launches and Deep Linking (content selection).
lmsIntegration.jwksHintEducator: Used by the LMS to verify JWT signatures from this tool.
lmsIntegration.lmsSettingsDescription: Configure LMS Web Service URL and Token for your school. These are stored securely per school and used automatically during LTI launch to create classes and enrol students.
lmsIntegration.issuerUrlHint: The LMS issuer/base URL for the selected school (e.g. https://realitywork.lms.com).
lmsIntegration.clientIdHint: From Site admin → External tool → Manage tools.
lmsIntegration.lmsWebServiceTokenHint: Optional. Roster fallback; verified on Save if provided.
lmsIntegration.moodleWsTokenRequired: Moodle web service token is required to verify the connection

lmsIntegration.testBeforeSaveHint: Test Connection must succeed before you can save.

lmsIntegration.saveVerifiesHint: Save verifies the connection first. Settings are only stored when verification succeeds.

lmsIntegration.invalidCanvasIssuerUrl: Invalid Canvas Issuer URL. For Canvas Cloud use https://canvas.instructure.com (or beta/test). For self-hosted Canvas, Issuer URL must match the Canvas base URL.
lmsIntegration.deploymentIdRequired: Deployment ID is required for Canvas
lmsIntegration.canvasApiTokenRequired: Canvas API token is required to verify Deployment ID
lmsIntegration.canvasSwitchInstructions: Switch Educator / Student, fill Client ID + Deployment ID for that tool, then save. Repeat for the other tool.
lmsIntegration.schoolHint: Select the school these LMS settings apply to.
lmsIntegration.schoolHintCanvas: Select school for Canvas Educator tool
lmsIntegration.clientIdHintCanvas: From Admin → Developer Keys (copy full ID)
lmsIntegration.deploymentIdHint: From setup email. Verified on Save with API token, else on first launch.
lmsIntegration.canvasDeploymentVerifiedOnLaunch: Saved. Have an instructor launch once from Canvas to confirm Deployment ID.
lmsIntegration.canvasApiTokenHint: Optional. Roster fallback; also verifies Deployment ID on Save.
lmsIntegration.deepLinkingDescription: Lets instructors pick simulations when adding activities in the LMS. Uses the same Educator tool URLs and Client ID — no separate RealityWorks config row.
lmsIntegration.deepLinkingSameAsEducator: Same URLs as Educator Portal above
lmsIntegration.deepLinkingNoExtraSave: No extra save needed here — your existing Educator LMS Settings row is used for Deep Linking launches.
lmsIntegration.deepLinkingMoodleStep1: Open Site administration → Plugins → External tool → Manage tools → your RealityWorks Educator tool.
lmsIntegration.deepLinkingMoodleStep2: Under Services, enable IMS LTI Assignment and Grade Services, Names and Role Provisioning, and Deep linking (Content-Item).
lmsIntegration.deepLinkingMoodleStep3: Use the same Initiate Login URL, Redirect URI, JWKS, and Tool URL shown in the Educator Portal card (or below).
lmsIntegration.deepLinkingMoodleStep4: To add simulation activities: Add activity → External tool → your RealityWorks tool → Select content to open the simulation picker.
lmsIntegration.deepLinkingMoodleStep5: Students launch from those activities into the student app — the same tool handles educator setup, Deep Linking, and learner launches. No separate student tool required.
lmsIntegration.deepLinkingCanvasStep1: Admin → Developer Keys → your RealityWorks Educator key → Placements.
lmsIntegration.deepLinkingCanvasStep2: Add placement Assignment Selection with message type LtiDeepLinkingRequest and Target Link URI from Educator Portal.
lmsIntegration.deepLinkingCanvasStep3: Enable LTI Advantage services: Assignment and Grade Services + Names and Role Provisioning.
lmsIntegration.deepLinkingCanvasStep4: Save the same Client ID and Deployment ID in LMS Settings. One Educator key handles class setup, Assignment Selection (picker), and student launches — no separate student key required.
lmsIntegration.setupStepDeepLinking: Enable Deep Linking on the Educator tool in your LMS (see Deep Linking section below).
